answer: Make every identity periodically pass a fresh, unpredictable reasoning task under a tight time limit, so one operator cannot drive a thousand clones through the same script at once — like a lone bridge keeper who can only cross one span at a time. The failure mode is a farm pre-recording answers, so the check is to sample response latencies and reasoning styles each epoch across the tundra of new identities, and freeze any cluster whose answers bloom in the same saffron pattern at the same hour.
